panels.title: List of Payments (Click ID to filter below)

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, transaction_id, amount, currency, state, created_at FROM payments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT timestamp as "Time", event as "Event", COALESCE(from_state, 'START') as "From State", to_state as "To State" FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId} ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT DISTINCT state::text as id, state::text as title, CASE WHEN state LIKE 'AUTH_%' THEN 'Authorization' WHEN state LIKE 'FRAUD_%' THEN 'FraudCheck' ELSE 'Main' END as "subTitle" FROM (SELECT COALESCE(from_state, 'START') as state FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId} UNION SELECT to_state FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId}) as nodes

SELECT id::text, COALESCE(from_state, 'START') as source, to_state as target, event as "detail__Event", CASE WHEN event = 'AUTHORIZE' THEN 'fraudCheckGuard' WHEN event = 'REFUND' THEN 'refundWindowGuard' WHEN event = 'COMPLETE' THEN 'AUTH_APPROVED AND FRAUD_PASSED' WHEN event = 'FAIL' THEN 'AUTH_REJECTED OR FRAUD_DETECTED' ELSE NULL END as "detail__Guard", CASE WHEN event = 'AUTHORIZE' AND to_state = 'AUTH_APPROVED' THEN 'feeCalculationAction' WHEN event = 'COMPLETE' THEN 'settlementAction' ELSE NULL END as "detail__Action", CASE WHEN event = 'AUTHORIZE' AND to_state = 'AUTH_APPROVED' THEN 'feeCalculationErrorAction' WHEN event = 'COMPLETE' THEN 'settlementErrorAction' ELSE NULL END as "detail__Error_Action" FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId} UNION ALL SELECT 'fake_auth' as id, 'PROCESSING' as source, 'AUTH_PENDING' as target, 'Start Region' as "detail__Event", NULL as "detail__Guard", NULL as "detail__Action", NULL as "detail__Error_Action" WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId} AND from_state = 'AUTH_PENDING') UNION ALL SELECT 'fake_fraud' as id, 'PROCESSING' as source, 'FRAUD_EVALUATING' as target, 'Start Region' as "detail__Event", NULL as "detail__Guard", NULL as "detail__Action", NULL as "detail__Error_Action" WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_history WHERE payment_id = ${paymentId} AND from_state = 'FRAUD_EVALUATING')
